crime: A decisive girl chose where the shared lounge items belonged. After free time, the girl named each place and {WITCH_NAME} touched the scattered objects to send them back. The decisive girl got an orderly room without carrying anything; she received praise for being fast and organized.

After one cleanup, the decisive girl fastened {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive, unfastened collar button in front of another prisoner. The girl then announced that the witch would plan and direct the next cleanup alone. She privately asked for one more set of choices. The decisive girl refused and told the witch that she was ready.

While the lounge was empty, {WITCH_NAME} took one of its swords and hid it behind a courtyard tree. The prisoner who had seen the button later settled in the lounge with the entrance in view. Afterward, a second prisoner spoke with the decisive girl beside the fountain.

{WITCH_NAME} retrieved the sword, drove it into the decisive girl's chest at close range, and killed her. The girl tore away the newly fastened button during the struggle. {WITCH_NAME} rinsed the blade in the fountain, touched it, and sent it to its assigned bracket in the lounge.

The body was found with the button in one blood-wet hand; the matching button was missing from {WITCH_NAME}'s collar. Every lounge sword appeared to be in its bracket, but a thin line of blood remained inside one sword's guard. That trace identified the murder weapon.

The fountain witness had seen the decisive girl alive after the lounge watch began, and the prisoner in the lounge had seen nobody enter before the body was found. The sword had therefore returned after the murder without passing through the entrance. The decisive girl had told {WITCH_NAME} where that sword belonged, so Assigned Return explained the impossible return.

{WITCH_NAME} claimed the button had fallen off earlier and another killer had planted it. The witness had watched the decisive girl fasten it shortly before the murder. Its place in the dead girl's blood-wet hand, together with the missing button at her collar, put {WITCH_NAME} within reach during the fatal struggle.
fields.epitaph: Every arrival bore her name; every road there had been chosen by someone else.
execution: A two-seat iron carriage faces a solid iron barrier. She is restrained in the rear passenger seat behind an empty driver's seat.

With nobody driving, the carriage accelerates straight into the barrier. The impact drives the restraints into her body and folds the carriage around her torso and skull. She remains crushed and dead in the passenger seat.

magic.name: Assigned Return
magic.text: She can send an object to a place another person assigned.
